summary: Post-door-gap-chain F1 re-census (PB-011C protocol, kernel door door_version 2, fresh python per row, serial, quiet machine at HEAD de33f33 post AUTHOR-FRAME-CARRIERS / FRAME-REVOLVE / SWEEP-PATH / BRIDGE-BOOLEANS / BRIDGE-LOFT-FACTS / TRIM-EXTRUDE-CTOR). ALL 21 F1 manifest rows were re-run through corpus/ttc/door.py --engine truck and their facts compared against the recorded references (solid_count exact, volume/bbox in the recorded bands). ZERO rows are facts-green: 0 green, 15 typed-refusal (refusing carrier named), 6 kernel-door DNF (untyped, recorded reason). The chain cured the entire Python authoring surface - no row refuses at Plane frame algebra, Pos placement, Spline profile authoring or the Vector data-row arithmetic any more - and the boundary moved into the native executor's carrier envelope: the dominant still-open carrier is the multi-station smooth loft (BRIDGE-LOFT-FACTS honesty line certifies only a two-station smooth loft; the corpus F1 body lofts are 7-19 station spline-section lofts), plus the TRIM-EXTRUDE-CTOR constructor (rear_wing/steering_rack/suspension_front/suspension_rear), the BRIDGE-BOOLEANS admission (airbox/details), a native facts refusal at drivetrain._fuse, two drop-in OCC-probe gaps (engine_cover/monocoque surfaces.bbox/obox -> Shape.wrapped refuses typed), the mirror carrier (drs_actuator), and two untyped DNF classes (corner rows surfaces.bbox on a Face whose wrapped is None -> OCP TypeError; floor/diffuser corpus floor-loft builder RuntimeError 'floor loft failed: None'). No OCC process ran anywhere in this packet (owner directive); the recorded references were the sole oracle, no reference or manifest was edited, no tolerance was stretched, and no concurrent door runs were made. Because no row flipped green, no kernel timing column was appended (A2 21 holds unchanged); the F1 kernel timing column stays closed row by row. The V5 net holds: the three previously-green FH timing rows (turbopump_assembly, chamber_assembly, fairing) answer bit-identically on the release build at this HEAD.

findings.title: No F1 row certifies on the post-chain kernel door
findings.detail: 0 green of 21; 15 typed-refusal and 6 kernel-door DNF. The door-gap chain cured the Python authoring surface for every row (no Plane/Pos/Spline/Vector refusal remains) and moved the boundary into the native executor's carrier envelope.

findings.title: The dominant still-open carrier is the multi-station smooth loft
findings.detail: The BRIDGE-LOFT-FACTS arm's honesty line certifies only a two-station smooth loft (a 3+-station smooth loft's station parameterization is an OCC ThruSections convention the row does not record). The corpus F1 body lofts are 7-19 station spline-section lofts (beam_wing 15, drs_flap 19, power_unit 16, track_rod_left/right 7), so they refuse typed. Closing the spline-loft class needs the recorded station parameterization or a certified multi-station smooth-volume arm.

findings.title: The trim rows do not close and the boolean rows do not flip
findings.detail: TRIM-EXTRUDE-CTOR refuses UnsupportedEnvelope on the corpus's real trim idioms (rear_wing _louvre_cutters; suspension _plate) and BRIDGE-BOOLEANS refuses the corpus's real boolean pairs (airbox _tcam, details mirror_optics), so those rows stay typed-refusal.

findings.title: Remaining drop-in data-surface gaps are the OCC probe and the Face.wrapped None
findings.detail: engine_cover/monocoque stop at surfaces.bbox/obox probing Shape.wrapped (the drop-in refuses typed); the four corner rows stop untyped because surfaces.bbox reads a drop-in Face whose wrapped property returns None and passes None into OCP BRepBndLib.Add_s. floor/diffuser stop untyped in the corpus floor-loft builder (surfaces.is_valid_shape swallows the refusal, so every trial loft is rejected and RuntimeError 'floor loft failed: None' is raised).

findings.title: V5 net holds; no reference drift
findings.detail: The three previously-green FH timing rows answer bit-identically on the release build at this HEAD (solid_count, volume, bbox, STL triangles). No reference or manifest was edited and no OCC process ran, so the reference-drift and OCC-flake stop conditions could not fire.

Typed refusals and DNF rows are valid outcomes (measurement, not a lift packet); no row was tuned, no corpus script was edited, no tolerance was stretched, no benchmark timing was performed (no green row), and no concurrent door runs were made.
